transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm here because... I'm just so worn out. It's hard to even explain it. Just walking from my bedroom to the kitchen, it feels like I've been hauling lumber all day. And it doesn't matter how much I sit down or try to rest, I just... I don't get any energy back. I'm just completely drained.
How long have you been feeling this way?

It's been about four months now. Yeah, right around four months. It started right after my wife went back to working full-time, so I... I started spending most of the weekdays just alone at the house.
Over these past four months, have you noticed a change in your mood, such as feeling sad, hopeless, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I have. Pretty much every morning, I wake up with this... this really heavy, hopeless feeling right in my chest. It's just there as soon as I open my eyes. And honestly, some days I'll just go sit out in the garage and cry. I don't even know what started it most of the time, to be honest with you. It just happens.
Does your wife or anyone else notice you snoring loudly, gasping, or having pauses in your breathing while you sleep?

No, she hasn't mentioned anything like that. I don't think I snore much... or at least, not loud enough to bother her. And she definitely hasn't said anything about me gasping or stopping breathing. She's a pretty light sleeper, so I'm sure she'd let me know if I was doing that.
Over these past four months, have you noticed any unintentional change in your weight, either gaining or losing weight without trying to?
No, I haven't really noticed any change in my weight. I mean, I haven't been trying to lose or gain anything, and my clothes still fit about the same, so... no, I don't think my weight has changed.
Have you noticed feeling unusually cold, having dry skin, or being more constipated than usual over these past four months?

No, I haven't noticed any of that. I mean, I'm not feeling any colder than usual. My skin seems fine... and I haven't had any issues with being constipated, either. Everything's pretty much normal in that regard.
Have you noticed feeling unusually thirsty or needing to urinate more often than usual over the past few months?
No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I'm not really any thirstier than usual... and I haven't been going to the bathroom more often, either. It's all just been about the same as always.
Have you noticed your skin or nail beds looking unusually pale, or do you feel lightheaded or dizzy when standing up?
No, I haven't noticed anything like that. My skin looks normal to me, and... no, I don't get dizzy or lightheaded when I stand up. So, no, none of those things.
Have you ever had a period like this before, in the past, where you felt similarly depressed or lost interest in things for several weeks or more?

No, I haven't. I mean, I've had normal bad days in the past, just like anybody, but... never anything like this. I've never felt this down or just lost interest in everything for weeks on end before. This is the first time it's ever been like this.
